profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer Front End
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
About me:
I am a Senior Frontend Engineer experienced in developing scalable web applications using Javascript, Typescript, React and modern front end libraries. I have familiarity with the technologies used in building full stack applications. I have worked with modern build tools, testing libraries, deployment practices, and have a proven track record leading projects to successful completion. I have a passion for building intuitive user experiences, love converting designs into pixel-perfect code, conducting A/B testing, improving accessibility, and optimizing applications for performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Frontend
positions.description:
Built a Merchant Portal experience using React and Next.js. 
Worked with State Management libraries to manage complex data sharing between components and page level features. Built dynamic form components to build user segments and lists and integrated them to build campaigns and target customers for E-Commerce brands leading to a sales increase of $13-16k in first week of the campaign duration.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · SASS · Website Development · TypeScript · CSS3 · JavaScript · Front-end · GraphQL · Document Object Model (DOM) · Jest

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description: Worked on AUI team, that manages the Component Library used to build features and experiences on the Amazon.com retail shopping website and native application. Was integral part of running experiments and roll-out strategies to overhaul the user experience on Amazon.com. Included updating styling of Buttons, Links, Inputs, Text, Form Fields, Color Pallette, etc. that billions of customers interact with annually.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · SASS · Website Development · Scrum · TypeScript · CSS3 · JavaScript · Front-end · Document Object Model (DOM) · Node.js

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description:
Worked directly with product managers, UX design, and fellow engineers to create customer facing experience to sell tickets on stubhub.com. Involved with sprint planning and retrospectives, code review, application architecture and helped define best coding practices. 
Technologies used: React, Redux, SCSS, Git, CI/CD tools
positions.insights: Skills: Git · SASS · Website Development · Scrum · CSS3 · JavaScript · Front-end · REST APIs · Document Object Model (DOM) · Jest · Redux.js
